governance.governing_invariant: The mathematics needs to earn the color.

2_source_raw_engine_results.engine_budget: Stockfish 18, 50000 nodes/child, Threads=1, Hash=16, fresh game token per child
2_source_raw_engine_results.notes: Single-threaded isolated configuration is structurally deterministic. However, unlike TARGET raw, no historical re-acquisition receipt exists demonstrating bit-identical reproduction across all 33,859 roots.

3_target_raw_engine_results.engine_budget: Stockfish 18, 250000 nodes/child, Threads=1, Hash=16, fresh game token per child
3_target_raw_engine_results.notes: Verified bit-identical in September 2026 Attempt 2 (commit 7dc937f), reproducing exactly d9b290bd... across 33,859 roots and 1,067,664 observations.

search_determinism_mechanisms.single_threaded: Threads=1 eliminates Lazy SMP thread races, search splitting jitter, and non-deterministic TT access races.
search_determinism_mechanisms.node_budget_stopping: Search terminates strictly upon consuming the exact node limit (50,000 for SOURCE, 250,000 for TARGET); time and depth limits are unbound.
search_determinism_mechanisms.per_child_tt_isolation: python-chess receives a fresh game token object per child move, issuing ucinewgame before each analysis. This clears Stockfish transposition tables and search history heuristics, preventing cross-move state contamination.
search_determinism_mechanisms.lexicographical_order: Legal moves are ordered strictly by UCI string (e.g. a2a3, a2a4, ...) ensuring invariant evaluation sequence.

empirical_evidence.target_raw_determinism: PROVEN: September 2026 Attempt 2 reproduced 33,859 records and 770,029,516 bytes matching SHA-256 d9b290bd... bit-for-bit.
empirical_evidence.source_raw_determinism: UNPROVEN: No full re-acquisition of SOURCE raw was recorded in repository history. While the execution parameters are structurally deterministic, byte-for-byte reproducibility of 7eb640c5... remains an unverified hypothesis.

projected_duration_current_hardware.hardware_model: Mac16,10 (Apple M4, 10 physical cores, 16 GB RAM)
projected_duration_current_hardware.hardware_match: Identical hardware model to September 2026 Attempt 2

resource_footprint.thermal_and_concurrency: Single-core load on a 10-core M4 generates minimal thermal output and allows normal interactive use without degradation.

interruption_and_resumption.durability_mechanism: Append-only JSON Lines with immediate f_out.flush() and os.fsync(f_out.fileno()) per completed root.
interruption_and_resumption.resumption_logic: On restart, runner reads output file sequentially, validates prior records against manifest, populates completed_roots, and resumes at first uncompleted root in exact manifest sequence.

stage_0_calibration_probe.description: Execute a 5-root test probe in an isolated scratch directory to verify that SourceFeasibilityRunnerV2 and TargetAcquisitionRunnerV2 initialize cleanly and emit identical records to historical test logs without side effects.

stage_1_source_acquisition.description: Reacquire missing SOURCE raw results under frozen SourceFeasibilityRunnerV2.
stage_1_source_acquisition.validation_gate: Strict equality of SHA-256 and byte size. If mismatch, STOP IMMEDIATELY. Do not proceed to TARGET acquisition.

stage_2_target_acquisition.description: Reacquire missing TARGET raw results under frozen TargetAcquisitionRunnerV2.
stage_2_target_acquisition.validation_gate: Strict equality of SHA-256 and byte size against seal V2. If mismatch, STOP IMMEDIATELY.

stage_3_v6_target_label_derivation.description: Materialize canonical V6 pair labels from verified SOURCE and TARGET raw artifacts.
stage_3_v6_target_label_derivation.validation_gate: Verify decompressed SHA-256 and byte size against seal V2.

stage_4_durable_preservation.description: Establish 3-layer preservation before downstream production training.

layers.layer_1_methodology: Git version-controlled protocol, runners, tests, and seals in repository.
layers.layer_2_repository_evidence: Canonical uncompressed execution cache and compressed transport artifact in artifacts/research/cp_target_labels_2026_07/.
layers.layer_3_external_independent_backup: Full replica of verified artifacts (SOURCE raw, TARGET raw, V6 compressed, V6 uncompressed) written to /Volumes/EXHD/ChessHeat_Preserved_Evidence/ with cryptographic receipts.

stage_5_production_admission_reentry.description: Re-run non-training preflight admission checks under V17 infrastructure; verify all 8 checks pass; await explicit user authorization for real production training.

concrete_blockers.engine_execution_unauthorized: Engine execution is strictly unauthorized under AGENTS.md and current session boundaries without explicit human authorization.
concrete_blockers.source_determinism_unverified: SOURCE raw determinism has not yet been demonstrated in an empirical re-acquisition run. If SOURCE raw diverges by even a single byte, live derivation will fail closed.

verdict_rationale: All prerequisites, tools, environments, hardware, configurations, and scripts are verified and present. TARGET raw reproducibility is empirically verified by historical Attempt 2. However, because SOURCE raw re-acquisition has never been empirically verified in the repository history, exact end-to-end bit reproducibility cannot be claimed as verified prior to execution. The staged execution plan is prepared and bounded by fail-closed validation gates, pending explicit human authorization to begin.
